description:
The Disable Marriage Scheme also known as Divyang Lagna Sahay was launched by the Government of India in the year 2016. 

This scheme aims to support the marriage of persons with disabilities. 

The initiative recognizes the challenges faced by individuals with disabilities in finding suitable partners. 

It seeks to provide financial assistance to encourage and facilitate marriages among disabled individuals. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to promote social inclusion and empower persons with disabilities. 

The scheme aims to reduce the stigma associated with disabilities in the context of marriage. 

The government has set a target to assist at least 10,000 marriages of persons with disabilities annually. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is set at ₹50,000 per marriage. 

This amount is intended to cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony. 

Eligible beneficiaries can receive this financial support only once. 

The scheme is applicable to individuals with disabilities as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. 

This act recognizes 21 types of disabilities including blindness, low vision, leprosy cured persons, hearing impairment, and more. 

To qualify for the financial assistance, the applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 

For female applicants, the minimum age requirement is 18 years. 

For male applicants, the minimum age requirement is 21 years. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at ₹2.5 lakh per annum. 

This income limit applies to the combined income of both partners if they are applying together. 

The application process for the Disable Marriage Scheme involves several steps. 

Interested applicants must first obtain the application form from the local office of the Department of Social Welfare. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

Applicants must fill in the required details accurately in the application form. 

Along with the application form, several documents are required. 

These documents include proof of disability issued by a competent authority. 

Applicants must also provide proof of age such as a birth certificate or school leaving certificate. 

Income proof is required to demonstrate that the annual income does not exceed ₹2.5 lakh. 

Additionally, applicants must submit a marriage certificate or proof of marriage. 

Once the application is completed with all necessary documents, it must be submitted to the local Social Welfare Department. 

The application will then be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The review process typically takes about 30 days from the date of application submission. 

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

The disbursement is made in a single installment of ₹50,000. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The Department of Social Welfare at the state level is responsible for the execution of the scheme. 

Contact details for the Department of Social Welfare can be found on the official state government websites. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance the quality of life for persons with disabilities. 

It aims to promote their rights and ensure their participation in society. 

The Disable Marriage Scheme is also aligned with the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. 

This convention emphasizes the importance of social inclusion and the right to marry. 

The scheme has been positively received by various NGOs and advocacy groups. 

They have highlighted its potential to change societal perceptions about disabilities. 

The government has also conducted awareness programs to inform potential beneficiaries about the scheme. 

These programs aim to reach out to disabled individuals and their families. 

The scheme has seen a steady increase in applications since its launch. 

In the first year alone, approximately 5,000 applications were received. 

By the end of 2022, this number had increased to over 15,000 applications. 

The government has committed to enhancing the budget allocation for this scheme annually. 

In the financial year 2022-2023, the budget allocation for the Disable Marriage Scheme was ₹100 crore. 

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to supporting persons with disabilities. 

The scheme also aims to create a supportive environment for disabled individuals to lead fulfilling lives. 

It encourages families to consider marriage as a viable option for their disabled members. 

The Disable Marriage Scheme is a significant step towards ensuring equality and dignity for persons with disabilities. 

It addresses not only the financial aspect of marriage but also the social barriers that exist. 

The scheme is a part of the larger framework of welfare schemes aimed at empowering marginalized communities. 

It complements other initiatives such as the Accessible India Campaign and the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana. 

These initiatives collectively aim to improve the living conditions and opportunities for persons with disabilities. 

The Disable Marriage Scheme is a crucial intervention in promoting the rights of disabled individuals. 

It provides them with the necessary support to make informed choices about their personal lives. 

The scheme has the potential to significantly impact the lives of many individuals and families across India. 

By facilitating marriages, it also promotes family stability and social acceptance. 

Overall, the Disable Marriage Scheme represents a progressive approach to addressing the needs of persons with disabilities in India. 

It is a testament to the government's commitment to inclusivity and social justice. 

The scheme continues to evolve as more feedback is received from beneficiaries and stakeholders. 

This feedback is essential for refining the implementation process and enhancing its effectiveness. 

The Disable Marriage Scheme is an important part of India's journey towards a more inclusive society. 

It reflects the changing attitudes towards disabilities and the importance of social integration. 

The government remains focused on ensuring that no one is left behind in the pursuit of equality and dignity.
